verdict.rationale: Brex's docs explicitly describe assigning top-line budgets to teams/projects, auto-enforced spend limits (stipends, travel, procurement), multi-level approval flows routed automatically by amount/vendor/role, and a Budgets/Spend Limits API for programmatic control, directly matching the finance-lead's need for enforced budget-to-card-limit-to-approval flows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that enforcement works reliably in practice (community evidence is unrelated to this axis, only covering account closures).
